9.II Vijayanagar and Other Kingdoms
VIJAYANAGAR EMPIRE : 1336-1565 AD
Vijayanagar kingdom and the city were founded by Harihar and Bukki
(soniste Sangama) who were feudatories of Kakatiyas and later became
minister in the court of Kampili.
Vijayanagar kingdom lay in the Deccan; to the south of the Bahmani
kingdom
